assets.brief: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE production MOBILE PORTRAIT background 1024x1536 (2:3), composed for a tall phone screen (not a crop of a landscape image). The entrance gate scene (Iljumun) of this same temple. A small, rounded, adorable Korean one-pillar-style temple gate (two sturdy terracotta-rose pillars, a plump curved plum-gray tiled roof, mint/pink/gold dancheong under the eaves) standing at the end of a quiet moonlit forest path, with a pair of warm glowing paper lanterns hanging from the gate. Soft rounded pine and magnolia trees frame both sides. Through the gate opening, far in the distance, the warm glowing temple hall of the reference with a tiny golden pig Buddha silhouette (small, no interior detail). Big full moon at upper right. Bottom center: a broad empty cream-peach stone-slab path leading toward the gate, clear and unobstructed. Landmarks in the upper 65%, wide empty floor in the lower third. Same world, same painting as the reference: Code Destiny Moonlit Lotus Temple. Premium soft digital watercolor + gouache storybook background with subtle paper grain and soft gradients, not flat cel shading, not photorealistic, not 3D. Thin 1–2px warm dark-brown/maroon outlines, never black. Rounded, short, plump Korean hanok architecture with softly curved eaves, muted plum-gray roof tiles (#5A4A70), terracotta-rose pillars (#D77068), mint/pink/gold dancheong patterns, repeated lotus motifs. Palette: cream-peach stone paving (#FECEB3), warm apricot wood (#FBAA7A), lavender twilight sky (#CEAFD5), moon cream (#FFE1B7), lotus/magnolia pink (#F2A7B3), golden accents (#E57E2D), indigo-violet water (#3E4A80), sage lotus leaves (#8FA08A). Light: big full moon plus warm lanterns with soft golden bloom; shadows painted violet or maroon, never gray. Night sky but the foreground stays bright and warm like dusk — do NOT darken the whole image. Cozy, adorable, serene, uncluttered. Keep a generous EMPTY clear floor at bottom center for a separately animated character. No people, no animals or living characters, no text, letters, signs, UI, borders or watermark.

Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE production MOBILE PORTRAIT background 1024x1536 (2:3), composed for a tall phone screen (not a crop of a landscape image). The bell pavilion scene (Beomjonggak) of this same temple at night. A small, plump pavilion-style hanok bell house on a low stone platform with terracotta-rose pillars and a curved plum-gray roof, a round bronze-gold temple bell hanging inside with a wooden striking log (dangmok) suspended on ropes beside it. Viewed slightly from the left and wide, so behind it the lotus pond and part of the reference temple hall roof overlap in the background, clearly the same temple. A very large full moon in the sky, and a few small pink lotus lanterns faintly floating up into the lavender sky (small, far away). Bottom center: a broad empty cream-peach stone-slab floor, clear and unobstructed. Landmarks in the upper 65%, wide empty floor in the lower third. Same world, same painting as the reference: Code Destiny Moonlit Lotus Temple. Use case: game prop sprite, square 1024x1024. A cute plump round bronze-and-gold Korean temple incense burner (hyangno) standing on three short stubby legs, with a lotus-patterned domed lid detail around the rim and gentle golden highlights, three thin unlit incense sticks standing upright in it (no fire, no smoke). Painted in the same soft watercolor + gouache storybook style as the reference, thin warm dark-brown outlines, never black, adorable rounded proportions. Bottom of the legs sits within the lowest 4% of the object's padding area. Single isolated prop on a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background filling the whole canvas, centered, complete silhouette with generous padding, no ground, no cast shadow, no scene, no gradient or texture in the background, and do not use any green color inside the prop itself. Crisp clean edges against the green. No text, no watermark.

Use case: game prop sprite, square 1024x1024. A cute Korean lotus lantern (yeondeung): a rounded lotus flower made of soft pink paper petals with white-cream tips, sitting on a small golden lotus base, a short golden tassel hanging below. It is LIT: warm golden candle glow from within, the petals softly luminous, a gentle warm glow contained inside the silhouette (no glow halo spreading onto the background). Same soft watercolor + gouache storybook style as the reference, thin warm dark-brown outlines, never black, adorable rounded proportions. Front view, upright. Single isolated prop on a perfectly flat, uniform pure chroma-key green (#00FF00) background filling the whole canvas, centered, complete silhouette with generous padding, no ground, no cast shadow, no scene, no gradient or texture in the background, and do not use any green color inside the prop itself. Crisp clean edges against the green. No text, no watermark.

assets.derivation: 노랑(hue 35–75°)을 같은 명도의 모브로 85% 이동 → 전체 채도 ×0.85·밝기 ×0.65 → #7c6fa8 multiply 30% (등갓 y<290만; 금 받침·술은 밝기 ×0.65·채도 ×0.75), alpha 동일
